title: Average No-Show Rates by Service Industry
subtitle: Share of booked appointments never fulfilled
description: Horizontal bar chart of average no-show rates by service industry. The all-service average is 23% (systematic review of 105 studies). Medical practices average 20% (midpoint of an 18-23% range), med spas 18% (16-21% range), and dental clinics 17% (15-20% range). Source: Journal of General Internal Medicine systematic review (Dantas et al., Health Policy 2018); FullSlot 2026 industry benchmarks.
